title: CubicExt::mul Karatsuba SoA batched SIMD
description:
## Current

`gfpn::CubicExt::mul` (`crates/gf2-core/src/gfpn/cubic.rs`) does Karatsuba-3 (6 base-field multiplications). No SoA batched path.

## Fix

Apply the same V2 ILP + V3 SIMD + SoA scaffolding from C4 to the cubic case. Reuse C4's SoA module structure.

## Per-kernel execution protocol

Same as C1. Bench: `field_matrix_fusion.rs` and `field_matrix_gemm.rs` (the gemm bench already covers cubic).

## Success criteria

- [hard] Bit-exact vs. existing AoS `CubicExt::mul`.
- [hard] AoS path unchanged.
- [hard] SoA path covers add, sub, mul, square.
- [aspirational] ≥1.5× geomean on `field_matrix_gemm` cubic-field row when both C3 + C4 + C5 land.
